The day of the second short-distance GⅠ 
race... The Sprinters Stakes.

With its daunting slope right before the 
goal, Nakayama Racecourse is the perfect 
stage to bring out the best in Taiki 
Shuttle!

Imagining the post-match party, Taiki 
Shuttle cheerfully took to the track.
